title: Network Engineer
description:
Network Engineer
Job Number: 26-00917

Progress on your journey to success! ECLARO is currently recruiting for a Network Engineer in the Chesapeake, VA area for one of our clients.

ECLARO’s client is a leading provider of healthcare workforce software and solutions. If you’re up to the challenge, then take a chance at this rewarding opportunity!

Qualifications:
  • Should have a solid understanding of L2 switching (i.e. fully understand VLANs, tagging, trunking, AAA, Spanning Tree, etc.) and a foundational knowledge of L3 networking, including subnetting (IPv4 public vs private class A, B, & C subnets).
  • Familiarity with routing protocols like OSPF and EIGRP, a basic grasp of Wi-Fi, and a strong understanding of switch installation best practices (i.e. proper network cabling, power considerations, etc.).
  • Core Focus: Solid understanding of Layer 2, foundational Layer 3, and introductory Wi-Fi concepts.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Layer 2 (Switching):
      • VLAN creation, tagging, and trunking.
      • Port security and access control.
      • Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) fundamentals (PVST+, RSTP).
      • 802.1X basics and AAA authentication concepts.
      • Mac address tables and ARP understanding.
    • Layer 3 (Basic Networking):
      • IPv4 addressing and subnetting (Class A / B / C, private vs public).
      • Default gateways and static routing.
      • Intro to routing protocols (basic OSPF and EIGRP concepts).
    • Wi-Fi (Introductory Level):
      • Understanding SSIDs, channels, and basic RF concepts.
      • Wi-Fi standards overview (802.11a / b / g / n / ac / ax).
      • Basic AP set up and controller awareness.
      • Wi-Fi troubleshooting basics (signal strength, interference).
    • Installation & Best Practices:
      • Switch installation, racking, and cabling standards.
      • Power and grounding considerations (PoE, UPS).
      • Network documentation and labeling.
    • Tools & Soft Skills:
      • Familiarity with network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, etc.).
      • Wireshark basics for packet inspection.
      • Clear communication and adherence to change management procedures.

Pay Rate: $35 - $38 / Hour
